description: This file defines an interface IOrderService, which declares a method for creating orders asynchronously within the application core of the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: IOrderService
classes.description: An interface for order-related operations, primarily providing an asynchronous method to create an order with a specified basket ID and shipping address.

methods.name: CreateOrderAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an order given a basket ID and shipping address.
